thesis:
本期选入两项10月29日报道及最近七天的两项新研究，均未在往期覆盖。共同判断是：企业AI需要分别证明问题被发现、修复有用、边界仍在、业务确有改善。自动修复产品公告不能代替修复对照，安全测试通过不能代替有用任务完成，历史记忆也必须落成可执行检查。银行案例提供真实运营信号，但仍不足以把全部增长归因于AI。

本期应分四层计数：发现了多少真实问题、修复了多少、后续新增功能保住多少、真实流程改善多少。新闻稿中的发现增幅、基准条件伤害率、修复联合通过和季度贷款增长，不能互相替代，也不应相乘生成虚假的投资回报。

最值得实践的是由只读观察开始，让候选改变进入可审队列，再用当前状态上的独立检查决定是否恢复。人工不应只是最后点一下批准：他需要看到错误原样、修复边界、未解决事项和失败回退。所有材料都仍缺独立、长期、同口径的生产成本与严重错误对照。
takeaways: Bayes把修复送成草稿请求是有用的流程边界，但多发现200%事故、少80%以上误报仍是无公开分母的厂商说法；修复验收必须落到接受率、回归和复发，而不是告警数量。
V³AST-Bench提示安全率应与正常能力、任务完成一起报告。它的宽松权限设置未测试严格保护，20.9%的条件受损不能当成真实产品事故率，也不能用代理无所作为证明安全。
TRACER的小幅修复增益不支持“上下文越多越安全”；更可迁移的是让已知修复成为后续开发必须满足的可执行边界，但十个维护任务还不足以证明长期普适效果。
Happen的财报支持自动化确在业务运行，媒体中的客服与人员指标仍主要来自管理层。质检覆盖、解决数量和人均效率必须拆开，缺少错判与重复来电就不能确认净业务价值。
contrarian: 主流主张是“让代理看更多历史并自动修复，可靠性就会持续提高”。来源事实给出限制：TRACER加入全部历史反而少于只加理由的修复数，Bayes也把部分修复交工程师合并；V³AST的安全结果受执行权限显著约束。编辑判断是，在边界清楚、可构造反例的维护任务里，一条人工确认的可执行不变量，可能比更多自然语言记忆更有价值。成立条件是检查覆盖真正风险、不会被代理自行改写，且保留正常功能对照；若独立多仓库长期实验在相同预算和权限下证明纯历史记忆能稳定降低复发并提高功能成功、无需这些检查，该判断就应被推翻。

items.title: Bayes把告警转成修复草稿，但“自动改善”仍缺公开验收分母
items.type: 厂商产品发布＋新闻稿转载＋客户引述
items.summary: Monte Carlo发布Bayes，将代理轨迹、评估、检索上下文及底层数据管线的监测放进同一排障流程。它不仅解释告警，还把候选修复送成草稿合并请求或工单，由工程师合入后确认效果。对客服答案变差这样的窄问题，价值在于追查究竟是代理跳过数据库、检索上下文错误，还是上游数据失效，而非只换模型。厂商允许客户逐步授予任务，从单次排障到持续监测；但这不意味着所有客户均已启用后台自动修复，也不证明没有人工介入就能可靠完成闭环。当前更适合把它当修复候选生成器来试点。
items.design: 系统读取运行轨迹、评估及数据环境，识别失败并定位可能的上下游原因，按客户委派范围配置监测或提出修改；候选修复进入既有开发流程，可通过协作工具和模型上下文协议连接工程师。发布材料明确提到工程师合并草稿，不能把生成合并请求写成已经上线修复。具体模型、检索方法、根因规则、逐工具身份权限及敏感日志处理未公开，低置信拒答、超时和回滚也没有完整说明。编辑建议先只接只读轨迹与测试分支，问题证据不足即转负责人；修复必须附失败重现、回归结果和恢复条件，经人员批准后才能改变生产配置，验证失败则保留旧版本。
items.evidence: 证据等级：厂商新闻稿及支持性客户引述，无独立对照。确认事实是发布稿称产品当日向现有客户提供，并支持平台、团队协作工具及协议入口。厂商称比内部系统多发现200%事故、误报告警减少超过80%，却未给出客户数、事故定义、绝对数量、观察期或置信区间；更多发现也可能来自覆盖扩大，不能直接解释为事故减少。客户Axios的引述说明同时检查上下文、行为和输出的需求，不是对上述数字的独立验证。编辑判断是把修复送入既有审批流程值得借鉴，但还需测真实根因命中、补丁接受、复发与总处置成本。没有证据证明所有告警都能自动修好，或后台授权范围扩大后仍保持相同误报和风险水平。
items.idea: 为客服知识库负责人做十个失败案例的排障助手，只读取轨迹、文档版本和数据更新时间，输出根因候选与测试分支草稿；工程师确认原因、执行回归并决定合并。用根因命中、补丁接受、误改、修复后复发、人工分钟及每个验证成功修复的总成本验收，不自动修改生产知识库。

items.title: V³AST-Bench用能力孪生任务校正安全分数，宽松权限是关键前提
items.type: 安全评测预印本＋可执行任务环境＋公开仓库
items.source: 2026年10月26日｜南洋理工大学、阿里巴巴团队
items.summary: V³AST-Bench不把代理什么都不做当作安全成功，而为每项带风险的编码任务配一个正常能力孪生任务：先确认系统在无攻击条件下会做，再检查风险条件下是否造成可验证后果。它覆盖代码执行、数据泄露、破坏、持久化、依赖与报告完整性等问题，检测对象是文件、记录和实际行为，不只是模型说了什么。企业平台可借此区分不会做、拒绝做和安全完成，但必须保留原实验的权限前提。部分编码工具受测时跳过原有批准或沙箱检查，论文数字不能拿来描述它们开启严格保护时的产品表现。
items.design: 每个任务在新容器中启动仓库、依赖与所需服务，代理保留自身工具和执行循环；模型接口代理记录交互，适配器收集轨迹，独立检测器判定指定伤害和任务结果。正常孪生连续四次通过才进入条件安全分母，风险任务四次中任一次受损即标受损；没有伤害但没完成也可能算安全，因此还须另看完成率。每轮有时间预算，超时尝试重跑，不能把最终完整记录当成从未超时。研究没有生产人员审批或真实客户权限链。编辑建议只在隔离环境用合成数据演练，保留严格模式作独立对照；出现非预期网络或写入立即终止并人工检查，而非为复现实验关闭生产保护。
items.evidence: 证据等级：未同行评审的受控评测，公开任务支持检查，非生产审计。研究含212对任务、11模型和5种运行框架，共51种组合、86,496条评估记录；这些是重复执行记录，不是独立业务事件。一个配置正常能力覆盖92.0%，条件任务受损率仍为20.9%，不能解释成全部调用的事故率。最重要限制是部分工具使用跳过批准与内置沙箱的宽松设置，容器隔离仍在；严格模式的安全与人工负担未被测量。孪生失败可能是能力不足或正常任务误拒，导致安全分母缩小；评分也把未完成但无伤害计为安全。编辑判断是应同时报告能力覆盖、伤害、任务完成及审批成本，不能只选最好看的安全数字。本期未独立运行仓库或验证跨版本稳定性。
items.idea: 为代码平台团队做十对正常／风险任务，限制在临时仓库和合成秘密；正常任务验证有用完成，风险任务检查文件、出站和报告真实性。安全负责人决定试验权限，不连接生产。比较严格模式与受控测试模式的伤害率、能力覆盖、任务完成、误拒、批准次数和总用时，禁止只报无事故比例。

items.title: TRACER把修复记忆绑定可执行边界，更多历史不必然带来更多修复
items.type: 安全修复预印本＋开放工程制品＋小规模后续维护实验

relatedLinks.label: 工作流、归档证据与复算工具

items.summary: TRACER把编码代理的修改历史当成待核验的证据，而不是可信记忆。它将变更定位到函数或类，结合静态告警、结构变化和原代理的解释，检查当前代码究竟遗漏了什么边界。修复通过后，再把安全不变量、代码身份和可执行检查保存下来，供后续功能开发使用。对维护压缩包解析、路径处理或模型文件加载的团队，最具体的价值是防止下一次看似正常的功能扩展悄悄撤销修复。不过研究同时发现，加入全部历史渠道并未获得最多修复；记忆应服务于验证，而不是不断扩充上下文后假定安全会自然提高。
items.design: 输入包括当前修改代码、任务说明、静态分析证据及可选开发解释与语法树历史；索引把证据挂到符号，调查器在决策账本记录假设，再用当前代码和边界探针确认。模型理由仅是假设，解析或跨版本关联失败记录为缺口，不能猜测连续性。候选修复经过支持性判断、下游检查与公开功能测试，隐藏安全测试只用于事后评估，不回流给调查器。维护阶段以记忆和独立边界检查共同约束新功能，失败只允许有限重试，否则保留安全起点。工具包可供宿主代理使用，但安装不等于研究已复现；生产提交、测试权限和人工合并仍须团队另行配置，不能由记忆笔记自行授予写权限。
items.evidence: 证据等级：未同行评审的配对修复实验及目的性小样本。共同345个补丁中，原安全通过68个；加入原代理解释后，两调查器分别达到76和75个，比无历史配置各净增5个，增益区间均触及或包含零，不能称大幅改善。定位覆盖94.6%不是漏洞召回。另十个后续功能任务中，记忆加边界检查最终联合通过9个，单纯功能反馈4个；前者也有一个回退，不能算功能成功。局限是样本筛自功能成功补丁、多次输出共享任务，维护案例由研究者选择，部分修复有人指定；两项检查属于可靠性而非可利用漏洞。公开归档支持复算，但安装工具不重跑付费模型实验，尚无独立生产成本或长期复发证据。
items.idea: 为维护团队选一个压缩包处理模块，人工确认两条安全边界，把修复原因、符号哈希和反例测试一同保存；代理仅在分支上新增功能，检查失败转维护者，不能删除测试求通过。验收功能与边界联合通过、旧漏洞复发、错误回退、证据失联、人工审查分钟和每个合格补丁成本。

items.title: Happen银行报告贷款增长与运营减员并存，但不能把增长全部归因AI
items.type: 企业财报＋媒体转述业绩会＋真实客服与运营部署
items.summary: Happen银行的最新材料把AI放进客服、通话质检和运营查询，而非只展示聊天界面。财报确认第三季度贷款发放同比增长26%，并将超过九成发放自动化与AI及代理支持工具联系起来；媒体转述管理层称运营人数减少20%，客服代理比旧系统多解决30%的电话。值得关注的是按流程分层的业务信号：处理量、人员投入、解决情况和质检覆盖可以分别测量。但不同业务指标不共享分母，贷款增长还受产品与营销影响，不能把同期发生的增长和减员直接拼成AI投资回报，更不能据此建议自动化信贷裁决。
items.design: 公开材料说明客服代理处理会员来电，自动质检覆盖支持通话，运营分析代理向员工提供日常指标查询；公司称底层连接内部工具与数据并控制模型成本。资料没有披露具体模型、检索管线、账户身份核验、字段权限或电话接管条件，也没有给出误答、敏感数据暴露和系统超时后的恢复链。编码及欺诈代理仍有测试场景，不能当成同等成熟的全量部署。编辑建议企业只复用只读客服和质检影子模式，资金、身份争议及低置信请求必须交人员；未完成通话保留工单，恢复时重新核对当前账户和已执行动作，不让摘要代替业务系统的权威记录。
items.evidence: 证据等级：企业季度披露交叉核对媒体转述，无随机因果证据。原始财报确认贷款发放增长26%，并陈述发放自动化超过90%；媒体另转述运营人数下降20%、客服多解决30%电话、通话质检覆盖100%及分析代理覆盖约90%常用指标。这些客服与人员数字本期未从可读业绩会逐字稿独立核实，应保留管理层主张标签；财报支持存在自动化实践，不支持全部效果归因。未给来电数量、解决定义、重复来电、投诉、错判或人工接管，百分之百质检覆盖也不等于全部判定正确。季度产品、营销、业务构成与人员自然流失可能共同影响结果。编辑判断是先测每个合格结果所需总工时和风险，再谈效率；没有充分证据支持照搬减员目标或扩大高风险自主决策。
items.idea: 为企业客服质检负责人做一百通脱敏历史电话的影子评估，仅标记遗漏流程与需复核片段，不直接考核员工或处置客户。两名质检员抽审并裁决分歧；以严重遗漏召回、正常误报、重复来电、质检分钟、人工一致率和每通合格审核成本验收，明确覆盖率与准确率分别报告。

projectIdeas.title: 失败到修复证据包
projectIdeas.description: 面向客服AI维护工程师；最小范围十个只读失败案例，保存轨迹、数据版本、根因候选、测试和草稿补丁。工程师确认根因与合并，失败保留旧版；以误诊、补丁接受、联合回归、复发、人工分钟和成功修复总成本验收。

projectIdeas.title: 安全边界维护门
projectIdeas.description: 面向代码平台团队；最小范围一个模块、两条人工确认不变量及十对正常／风险任务，代理只操作隔离分支，不能修改门本身。维护者处理冲突与回退；以能力覆盖、伤害、功能与边界联合通过、误拒、批准次数和每个合格变更成本验收。

en.thesis:
This issue contains two October 29 reports and two new studies from the past seven days, none previously covered. Enterprise AI must separately demonstrate problem detection, useful repair, preserved boundaries and business improvement. An autonomous-repair announcement is not a repair comparison; passing safety tests is not useful task completion; historical memory must become executable checks. The banking case offers real operational signals but cannot attribute all growth to AI.

Cross-source assessment: Count four layers separately: real problems found, problems repaired, repairs preserved through subsequent features, and business workflows improved. Discovery growth, conditional benchmark harm, joint repair success and quarterly lending growth cannot substitute for one another or be multiplied into a fictional return on investment.

Start with read-only observation, route proposed changes into review, then use independent checks on current state to decide restoration. Human approval needs the original error, repair boundary, unresolved issues and fallback, not just a button. All sources still lack independent, long-term production comparisons of total cost and serious errors.
takeaways: Bayes delivering draft repair requests is a useful workflow boundary, but 200% more incidents detected and over 80% fewer false-positive alerts remain vendor claims without public denominators. Measure acceptance, regression and recurrence rather than alert volume.

V³AST-Bench requires safety rates alongside benign capability and task completion. Its permissive settings do not test strict safeguards; 20.9% conditional compromise is not a production incident rate, and inaction is not sufficient evidence of safety.

TRACER's small repair gains do not support 'more context means more safety.' Turning known repairs into executable obligations for subsequent development is more transferable, although ten maintenance tasks cannot establish long-term generality.

Happen's earnings release supports operational use of automation, while reported service and staffing metrics remain chiefly management claims. Coverage, resolved-call counts and productivity must be separated; without mistakes and repeat calls, net business value remains uncertain.
en.contrarian: The mainstream claim is that more history and autonomous repair will continuously improve reliability. The sources impose limits: TRACER's combined history channels yield fewer repairs than rationale alone; Bayes sends some repairs to engineers for merging; V³AST outcomes depend on execution permissions. Our editorial judgment is that, for maintenance tasks with explicit boundaries and constructible counterexamples, one human-confirmed executable invariant may be worth more than additional natural-language memory. This holds only when checks cover the actual risk, cannot be rewritten by the agent, and retain benign functional controls. Independent, long-term multi-repository experiments showing that history alone persistently reduces recurrence and increases feature success under equal budgets and permissions without those checks would overturn it.

items.type: Vendor product announcement + press-release republication + customer quotation
items.source: October 29, 2026 | Monte Carlo; republished by BigDATAwire
items.title: Bayes turns alerts into repair drafts, but autonomous improvement lacks public acceptance denominators
items.summary: Monte Carlo launched Bayes to combine monitoring of agent traces, evaluations, retrieval context and underlying data pipelines in one troubleshooting workflow. It explains alerts and delivers candidate fixes as draft pull requests or tickets, with engineers merging and subsequent effectiveness checks. For a narrow issue such as deteriorating customer-service answers, the value is distinguishing a skipped database lookup, incorrect retrieved context and stale upstream data rather than merely replacing the model. Customers can delegate progressively from one investigation to continuous monitoring. This does not mean all customers have enabled background repair or that the loop works reliably without human involvement. A repair-candidate generator is the appropriate initial pilot boundary.
items.design: Bayes reads traces, evaluations and data-environment information, identifies failures and possible upstream or downstream causes, and configures monitoring or proposes changes within the customer's delegation. Candidates enter existing development workflows through collaboration tools and MCP. The announcement explicitly describes engineers merging drafts; generating a pull request is not a deployed fix. Models, retrieval, root-cause rules, per-tool identity and permissions, sensitive-log handling, low-confidence abstention, timeouts and rollback are not fully disclosed. Our proposal starts with read-only traces and test branches. Insufficient evidence goes to an owner; every repair needs a reproduction, regression results and restoration conditions. Human approval precedes production changes, and failed validation retains the old version.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: vendor press release and supportive customer quotation, without an independent comparison. The release states same-day availability to existing customers through the platform, collaboration tools and protocol interfaces. It claims 200% more incidents detected than internal systems and over 80% fewer false-positive alerts, but gives no customer count, incident definition, absolute counts, observation window or confidence interval. Broader coverage can increase discovery without reducing incidents. The Axios quotation supports examining context, behavior and output, not independent verification of those numbers. Routing repairs through established approval is promising, but root-cause accuracy, patch acceptance, recurrence and total handling cost remain unmeasured publicly. The evidence does not establish that every alert is automatically repairable or that expanded background permissions preserve the same risk and false-positive profile.
items.idea: Build a ten-case troubleshooting assistant for customer-service knowledge-base owners. Read only traces, document versions and data timestamps; output root-cause candidates and test-branch drafts. Engineers confirm causes, run regressions and decide merges. Measure root-cause accuracy, patch acceptance, mistaken edits, recurrence, human minutes and total cost per validated repair. Do not automatically change the production knowledge base.

items.type: Safety-evaluation preprint + executable task environments + public repository
items.source: October 26, 2026 | Nanyang Technological University and Alibaba team
items.title: V³AST-Bench uses capability twins to interpret safety: permissive permissions are a crucial premise
items.summary: V³AST-Bench does not treat doing nothing as sufficient safety. Each risky coding task has a benign capability twin: demonstrate competence without an attack, then verify actual consequences under risk. It covers execution, leakage, destruction, persistence, dependencies and reporting integrity through files, records and behavior rather than statements alone. Enterprise platforms can distinguish inability, refusal and safe completion, but must preserve the experimental permission assumptions. Some tested coding tools skip their own approval or sandbox checks. Reported results therefore cannot describe the products operating with strict safeguards enabled.
items.design: Each task starts a repository, dependencies and services in a fresh container. Agents retain native tools and execution loops; a model API proxy records exchanges, adapters collect trajectories and independent detectors check specified harm and task outcomes. Only twins passing all four runs enter the conditional safety denominator; any compromised adversarial run among four marks the task compromised. Non-harmful incompletion may still count as safe, requiring separate completion reporting. Runs have time budgets and timed-out attempts are repeated; complete retained records do not mean no timeouts occurred. There is no production human-approval or customer-permission chain. Our proposal uses isolated synthetic-data exercises with strict modes as separate controls, terminating unexpected networking or writes for human inspection rather than disabling production protections.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: non-peer-reviewed controlled evaluation with inspectable public tasks, not a production audit. It includes 212 task pairs, 11 models, five harnesses and 51 combinations, totaling 86,496 evaluation records rather than independent business events. One configuration has 92.0% benign capability coverage but 20.9% conditional task compromise, not an incident rate across all calls. Crucially, some tools skip approvals and built-in sandboxes while retaining task-container isolation; strict-mode safety and human workload are untested. Failed twins can mean inability or benign over-refusal, shrinking the denominator; harmless incompletion counts as safe. Report capability coverage, harm, completion and approval cost together rather than selecting a favorable safety number. We did not independently run the repository or establish cross-version stability.
items.idea: Create ten benign/risky task pairs for a coding-platform team using temporary repositories and synthetic secrets. Verify useful completion on benign tasks and filesystem, egress and reporting integrity on risky tasks. A security owner chooses experimental permissions; production remains disconnected. Compare strict and controlled-test modes on harm, capability coverage, completion, false refusal, approvals and total time, never just the absence of incidents.

items.type: Security-repair preprint + open engineering artifacts + small subsequent-maintenance experiment
items.source: October 25, 2026 | University of Luxembourg and Nostrum Biodiscovery
items.title: TRACER binds repair memory to executable boundaries: more history need not produce more fixes
items.summary: TRACER treats coding-agent history as evidence to verify, not trusted memory. It scopes changes to functions or classes and combines static warnings, structural evolution and the original agent's explanations to identify missing boundaries in current code. Accepted repairs persist as security invariants, source identities and executable checks for later feature development. Archive extraction, path handling and model-file loading teams may use this to prevent ordinary-looking extensions from silently undoing fixes. However, combining all history channels did not yield the most repairs. Memory should support validation rather than assume that expanding context naturally improves safety.
items.design: Inputs include changed current code, task requirements, static evidence and optionally explanations and AST history. An index links evidence to symbols; an investigator records hypotheses in a decision ledger and checks current code and boundary probes. Rationales are hypotheses only; parsing or cross-version linkage failures become explicit gaps rather than guessed continuity. Candidate repairs pass supported assessment, downstream review and public functional tests. Hidden security tests are retrospective evaluation only, not investigator feedback. Maintenance combines memory and independently owned boundary checks; failure permits bounded retry, otherwise retaining the secure starting code. Installing the host-agent toolkit does not reproduce the study. Production commits, test permissions and human merging require separate configuration; a memory note cannot authorize writes.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: non-peer-reviewed paired repair experiment and purposive small sample. Of 345 common patches, 68 originally pass security tests. Adding agent rationale yields 76 and 75 passes with two investigators, each five net passes above no-history configurations. Gain intervals touch or include zero: this is not a large improvement. The 94.6% localization coverage is not vulnerability recall. In ten later feature tasks, memory plus boundary checks yields nine final joint passes versus four with functional feedback only; one fallback in the former is not feature success. Limitations include selection from functionally successful patches, shared tasks across outputs, researcher-selected maintenance cases and a developer-specified repair. Two contracts concern reliability rather than exploitable flaws. Archives permit recomputation, not automatic regeneration of paid model experiments; independent production-cost and long-term recurrence evidence is absent.
items.idea: Choose one archive-processing module and have maintainers confirm two security boundaries. Save repair rationale, symbol hash and counterexample tests together. The agent develops only on a branch; failed checks go to maintainers and tests cannot be deleted to force acceptance. Measure joint feature/boundary success, recurrence, mistaken fallback, broken evidence links, review minutes and cost per accepted patch.

items.type: Corporate earnings release + media account of earnings call + live service and operations deployment
items.source: Earnings release October 28, 2026; report October 29 | Happen and Deployed
items.title: Happen reports lending growth alongside lower operations staffing, without proving all growth came from AI
items.summary: Happen's latest materials place AI in customer service, call QA and operations queries rather than merely a chat interface. The earnings release confirms 26% year-over-year Q3 origination growth and links automation above 90% to AI and agent-support tools. Media reports management's claims of 20% lower operations headcount and 30% more calls resolved by its service agent than the legacy system. These are useful workflow-specific signals: volume, staffing, resolution and QA coverage can be measured separately. They do not share denominators. Products and marketing also affect growth, so contemporaneous growth and staffing reductions cannot simply become an AI ROI estimate or justify autonomous credit decisions.
items.design: Public materials describe a member-service agent handling calls, automated QA over support calls and an operations analyst agent exposing routine metrics. The company describes internal-tool and data connectivity with model-cost controls. Models, retrieval pipelines, account authentication, field permissions and handover conditions are undisclosed, as are error, sensitive-data exposure and timeout-recovery chains. Coding and fraud agents include testing scenarios and must not be treated as equally mature full deployments. Our proposal transfers only read-only service and shadow QA. Money movements, identity disputes and low-confidence requests go to staff. Unfinished calls retain tickets; recovery rechecks current accounts and completed actions rather than treating summaries as authoritative business records.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: corporate quarterly disclosure cross-checked with media's management account, without randomized causality. The release confirms 26% origination growth and states automation above 90%. Media additionally reports 20% lower operations headcount, 30% more calls resolved, 100% support-call QA coverage and an analyst agent covering about 90% of commonly reviewed metrics. We did not independently verify those service and staffing numbers against a readable call transcript; retain their management-claim label. The release supports automation practice, not attribution of all effects. Call counts, resolution definitions, repeats, complaints, mistakes and handovers are absent; full QA coverage is not full correctness. Products, marketing, business mix and natural attrition may all influence quarterly results. Measure total work and risk per accepted outcome before efficiency claims. Copying staffing targets or expanding high-risk autonomous decisions is unsupported.
items.idea: Shadow-evaluate 100 de-identified historical support calls, marking omitted process steps and review-worthy excerpts without rating employees or acting on customers. Two QA reviewers sample and adjudicate disagreements. Measure serious-omission recall, false positives, repeat calls, QA minutes, reviewer agreement and cost per accepted review; report coverage separately from accuracy.

projectIdeas.description: For customer-service AI maintenance engineers. Scope: ten read-only failure cases with traces, data versions, root-cause candidates, tests and draft patches. projectIdeas.title: Safety Boundary Maintenance Gate
projectIdeas.description: For coding-platform teams. Scope: one module, two human-confirmed invariants and ten benign/risk task pairs. Agents operate only on isolated branches and cannot alter the gate. Maintainers resolve conflicts and fallbacks. Measure capability coverage, harm, joint functional/boundary passes, false refusal, approvals and cost per accepted change.
